prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we reflect among all humanity the image of your divine goodness.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos refletir no mundo a imagem da vossa bondade.

meta.face: A MATRONLY woman of about forty-five, mother of eight, with a LONG, OVAL face — a high forehead, a long, straight, rather strong nose, almond-shaped hazel eyes under dark, arched brows, long, smooth cheeks with a faint colour, a small, firm, closed mouth and a long, rounded chin; ALL hair covered by the wimple and veil (no blonde hair, no plaits); a grave, thoughtful gaze lowered to the book. Mature and dignified, not girlish.
meta.basis: No portrait from life; the 13th-century genealogical roll shows her crowned over a white veil, and later windows give her fair golden hair. Her Gospel book, which Malcolm had bound in gold and silver and which survives in the Bodleian, is her attribute; St Margaret's Chapel on Edinburgh Castle and the Queen's Ferry are real places tied to her.
